{{Quote|But, Wicket, we don't even have a weapon!''"<br />"''Hmmmm! Maybe we do, Teebo!''"<br />"''That beehive? But what kind of weapon is this?''"<br />"''One with a sting&hellip;I hope!|[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], looking for a way to stop an [[Endorian swamp beast]]|<ref name="E4 ">[[Ewoks (1985) 4|''Ewoks'' 4]]</ref>}}
A '''bee''' was a small, winged creature that made a buzzing sound when in flight and stung painfully.<ref name="E4 " /> Bees had three main body regions: a head, a thorax, and an abdomen. Their heads featured twin feelers, a pair of large [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a proboscis. They had two sets of wings that were attached to the thorax; two fore wings and two hind wings. Their abdomen was large, amber-colored with black stripes and ended with a sting.<ref name="BEPS">''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]''</ref> The [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] compared the pain of his mending [[Bone/Legends|bones]] after the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'''s]] crash on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] to the sting of a bee.<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> The humming of an [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O]] [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] was sometimes compared to that of a huge bee.<ref name="ANHN">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref> Bees lived in oblong, dome-shaped nests called beehives, which hung from [[Tree/Legends|trees]].<ref name="E4 " /> Those flying creatures would bumble their way in the [[Flower/Legends|flowers]], incidentally helping pollinate the [[Plant/Legends|plants]] that bore them.<ref name="Y:DR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] refers to "[[Wikipedia:the birds and the bees|the birds and the bees]]" when [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Alema Rar]] start talking about sex and flower pollination on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

In [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], [[Wikipedia:Bee|real-world bees]] are seen in the flowery fields of the [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during a romantic scene involving [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]].
